title: clinopodium cimbricum
intro: Clinopodium cimbricum, commonly known as Wood Betony, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, helping to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium cimbricum include its ability to reduce fever, relieve headaches and digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
